budget.title: Full-Day Szentendre Nature Chill + Local Budget Food
budget.summary: A full-day nature-focused route along the Danube, quiet green paths, and affordable local Hungarian dishes.

schedule.title: Morning Walk Along the Danube Promenade
schedule.description: A gentle start to the day by the river — calm water, early boats, and the town slowly waking up.

schedule.title: Bükkös Creek Nature Trail
schedule.description: Walk along the small creek, cross its tiny bridges, enjoy the greenery, and snap some great photos.

schedule.title: Budget Local Lunch
schedule.description: Traditional Hungarian comfort food — goulash, stew, lángos, or sausages at a simple affordable spot.

schedule.title: Excursion to Szentendre Island
schedule.description: If the weather is nice, cross over to the island — peaceful walking paths, small beaches, and forested sections.

schedule.title: Return to Town + Short Café Break
schedule.description: Relax at a modest local café near the river and recharge for the final part of the day.

schedule.title: Sunset by the Danube
schedule.description: Finish the day sitting by the river as the sky turns orange — peaceful, simple, unforgettable.

comfortable.title: Full-Day Szentendre Nature Day with Comfortable Dining
comfortable.summary: A relaxed full-day nature itinerary with comfortable restaurants and scenic walking routes.

schedule.title: Coffee by the Danube
schedule.description: Start with a proper coffee or tea at a riverside café before you begin your walk.

schedule.title: Bükkös Creek Green Trail
schedule.description: Walk the tree-lined paths along the creek — perfect shadows, calm water, and plenty of nature around you.

schedule.title: Comfortable Local Lunch
schedule.description: A sit-down restaurant with traditional Hungarian dishes — hearty soup, main course, maybe dessert.

schedule.title: Skanzen Open-Air Museum
schedule.description: A short ride outside town to the Szentendre Open-Air Ethnographic Museum — huge open spaces, farm animals, old village houses, and beautiful nature.

schedule.title: Slow Walk Through Szentendre’s Quiet Streets
schedule.description: Avoid the touristy center and enjoy the quieter parts of town — gardens, courtyards, and peaceful residential lanes.

schedule.title: Dinner with a River View (Optional)
schedule.description: If you still have energy, finish with a nice meal at a restaurant near the river — perfect for ending a nature-themed day.

budget.title: Full-Day Szentendre Nature + Light Veggie Budget Plan
budget.summary: A nature-first day with light, affordable vegetarian options — easy on the stomach and the wallet.

schedule.title: Light Breakfast + Danube Walk
schedule.description: Pick up something simple from a bakery (pastry, fruit, yogurt) and start your riverside walk.

schedule.title: Veggie-Friendly Walk Along Bükkös Creek
schedule.description: Relax at the benches along the creek and enjoy a peaceful snack break if you brought something light.

schedule.title: Budget Veggie Lunch
schedule.description: Find a small bistro offering soups, salads, or meat-free pasta dishes.

schedule.title: Quiet Zone by the River
schedule.description: Relax in quieter riverside areas — reading, sketching, or simply soaking in the views.

schedule.title: Tea or Coffee Garden Break
schedule.description: A café with a garden is perfect for unwinding and resting your legs.

schedule.title: Light Veggie Snack to Wrap Up
schedule.description: A small final snack — cheese pastry, salad, or another veggie-friendly bite.

comfortable.title: Full-Day Szentendre Nature & Veggie Comfort Day
comfortable.summary: Green paths and carefully chosen light vegetarian meals — a perfect combination of nature and wellness.

schedule.title: Healthy Breakfast at a Café
schedule.description: Porridge, croissants, fruit bowls, or plant-based pastries — paired with a warm drink.

schedule.title: Nature Walk Along the Creek
schedule.description: Head through the quieter sections of the trail, surrounded by trees and flowing water.

schedule.title: Comfortable Veggie Lunch
schedule.description: A modern restaurant with salads, pasta, bowls, and creative vegetarian dishes.

schedule.title: Skanzen – Nature + Space
schedule.description: Explore the vast open-air museum — traditional houses, fields, gardens, and calm natural scenery.

schedule.title: Evening Walk Back by the River
schedule.description: A slow riverside walk as the sun starts going down.

schedule.title: Light Veggie Dinner
schedule.description: Another light meal at a comfy restaurant — nothing too heavy, just tasty and relaxing.

budget.title: Full-Day Szentendre Nature for Curious Tasters (Budget)
budget.summary: A day of walking and trying various small bites — a casual nature-focused tasting adventure.

schedule.title: Bakery Breakfast Tasting
schedule.description: Grab 2–3 different pastries from a local bakery and start walking along the Danube.

schedule.title: Snack Walk by the Creek
schedule.description: Bring along pretzels, nuts, or fruit for a casual tasting session as you walk.

schedule.title: Street Food Lunch
schedule.description: Try a couple of items — lángos, sausage, hot dog, or whatever looks good and affordable.

schedule.title: Island Picnic Stop
schedule.description: Head to Szentendre Island for a snack-filled mini picnic surrounded by nature.

schedule.title: Coffee + Dessert
schedule.description: Cappuccino, cake, pancakes — treat yourself.

schedule.title: Final Snack Before Sunset
schedule.description: A small bite to finish the tasting tour — whatever catches your eye.

comfortable.title: Full-Day Szentendre Nature & Tasting Experience
comfortable.summary: Nature walks combined with a curated tasting-style food day — a bit of everything, done comfortably.

schedule.title: Riverside Breakfast
schedule.description: Coffee, juice, pastry, maybe something sweet to start the day pleasantly.

schedule.title: Scenic Walk by the Danube
schedule.description: Low-paced walking and photography along the shoreline.

schedule.title: Tasting Lunch
schedule.description: A restaurant where you can share multiple smaller dishes — traditional, modern, and seasonal plates.

schedule.title: Skanzen Stroll
schedule.description: Open fields, old village houses, and peaceful corners — perfect post-lunch walk.

schedule.title: Afternoon Drink with a View
schedule.description: A beer, wine, lemonade, or soda at a place overlooking the river or garden.

schedule.title: Shared Plates for Dinner
schedule.description: End the day with a few more small dishes in a cozy bistro.
